falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 closes below the 200-day moving average by at least 3% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below key support would contradict the breakout pattern and invalidate the HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume on the NYSE exceeds 2.5 billion shares for 3 consecutive days with no price confirmation
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Excessive volume without price movement would indicate a blowoff top, directly contradicting the current HOLD verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: The CBOE VIX spikes above 35 and remains above 30 for 7 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained spike in volatility would indicate market panic, invalidating the pattern's expected continuation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
